items.text: Executable bun TypeScript script at skills/agent-usage-audit/scripts/agent-usage-audit emitting one normalized JSON audit record on stdout.
Never fabricate or estimate numbers; failures (missing store/session, unreadable, dropped rows) emit source "unavailable" with honest reason.
Probe order: `ccusage session --id <id> --json` if installed, then built-in adapters, then unavailable record.
agy: usage at gen_metadata.data→#1→#4 (#2,#3,#5,#9,#10); model #1→#19 fallback #21; drop rows where #3≠#9+#10; zero verified→unavailable.
Claude Code adapter dedups assistant turns by (message.id, requestId) pair; real transcript had 75 lines for 32 pairs.
Detect harness via env markers (OPENCODE=1, Claude Code markers) and store presence; skills hold no harness logic.
model_breakdowns array [{model, tokens, cost_usd}] per model; opencode extracts id from JSON model strings; map ccusage modelBreakdowns.
Bun + TypeScript only, no build step; no npm, pip, jq, or sqlite3 binary; use bun:sqlite, open stores read-only.
Subagent usage rolled into parent totals with per-child `children` array: Claude isSidechain turns, opencode parent_id sessions.
Shared record fields: schema, stage, harness, session id, source, models, model_breakdowns, tokens, cost passthrough, children, timestamp.
Tokens: input, output, cache_read, cache_write, reasoning, total; output includes reasoning; total = input+output+cache_read+cache_write.
Environment overrides for harness, session id, and every store path so adapters are testable against fixtures.
No price-list cost computation (passthrough only), no hook capture, no GitHub posting/ledger/rendering (#181), no skill wiring (#182).
bats tests: committed bun generator builds fixture DBs (*.db gitignored); dedup, sidechain, drift, model_breakdowns, unavailable per harness; just test-unit/test.
